integrity: The proof is analytic; numerical code only checks algebra and reported constants. Literature comparisons are stated as coverage assessments rather than a proof of uniqueness.
primary_subject_evidence: The direct source is classified by arXiv under Statistics Theory and Methodology and is published in Bernoulli; the broad MSC owner is recorded as 62.
scientific_limitations: The exact null law is restricted to the scalar Gaussian balanced two-way cross-fitted statistic.
The strict power comparison is local-asymptotic for fixed nonzero h and does not claim finite-sample power dominance.
The finite-sample critical value is an implicit quantile of a sum of two independent absolute Student variables.
title: Exact calibration and strict local-power dominance for scalar Gaussian two-way cross-fitting
